author: alaperto
body:
#### PR description:
C-RACK (Cosmic Rack) is Phase2 Tracker test stand (6 layers of 2S ladders).

This PR is starting from changes in PR #51977 .

Purpose: improve CRACK MC to match data (cosmics rays angles).

Modified:
- CRACK geometry file: tob.xml (bugfix, centering CRACK along Z axis)
- parameters used to produce MC: SimTracker/Configuration/python/customise_P2_CRACK.py (phiMax, radius, Z range)

#### PR validation:

Produced MC .root file.
Extracted DQM plots and compared to data, results in [Tracker BES meeting](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1747056/contributions/7342996/attachments/3379783/6070702/CRACK_data_DQM_Nov26.pdf)
title: [WIP] Update CRACK geometry and MC production script
